newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine's Kuchma sacks nuclear, oil and gas chiefs.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's Kuchma sacks nuclear, oil and gas chiefs.

text.p: President Leonid Kuchma sacked the heads of Ukraine's top nuclear and energy bodies after accusing them of incompetence, Kuchma's press service said on Wednesday.

"Bohdan Babiy, head of the oil and gas sector, and Viktor Chebrov, head of the Derzhkomatom nuclear body have been removed from their posts for not properly fulfilling their duties," a statement said.

The sackings were announced last week by Volodymyr Horbulin, secretary of Kuchma's policy-making Security and Defence Council, who cited problems such as unpaid bills to Ukraine's five nuclear power plants and nuclear fuel shortages.
Horbulin also criticised the monopolised gas system where the government picks gas suppliers.
